name: Search with ambient glow
for: A docs or command search field that gathers a soft light of the effect around it while it has focus, so the place you are typing is obvious without a loud ring.
how: aurora-curtains on a dark ground, grain-gradient on a light one, in a host behind the field, 22-30px larger on every side, blurred into ambient light; it fades in on focus and runs only then. A real combobox with a filtered list.
rules: The glow tints at most a few percent where it meets the field; text never sits on it.
Glow only on focus, never at rest.
a11y: An input with role combobox, a labelled listbox, aria-activedescendant for arrow keys, Enter to choose, Escape to clear; / focuses it. Reduced motion keeps the glow still.
